notes.title: Casual Mode Update
notes.content:
Many Players had a hard time playing this game and got frustrated.
At the start of a new game you have an option to play the game on easymode now.
This changes some mechanics and values for a less hardcore and more to the genre fitting gameplay.

Minor changes:
- Some characterart got reworked to look more aesthetic
- Parring attacks does extradamage now
- Monsters drop a bit more money

notes.title: Update
notes.content: Improved mouse movement and some fixes.
